title: Insurance Claim Estimator (Korea)
listing_description: Turn a Korean hospital receipt into an insurance payout estimate. Your agent reads policy certificates and receipts; the open-source insurance-claim-mcp server (MIT, runs locally via uvx) does the math with a fail-closed rule engine, so unverified riders return NOT_EVALUATED instead of a guess. Covers 실손 generations and common fixed-benefit riders, KCD code matching, and insurer document checklists. Estimates only, not a payout decision.
